sn9.8:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam aññataro bhikkhu Kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || 2.
sn9.8:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena so bhikkhu aññatarasmiṃ kule ativelam ajjhogāḷhappatto viharati || || 3.
sn9.8:1.3: Atha kho tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tassa bhikkhuno anukampikā atthakāmā tam bhikkhuṃ saṃvejetu-kāmā yā tasmiṃ kule kulagharaṇī tassā vaṇṇam abhinimminitvā yena so bhikkhu ten-upasaṅkami || || 4. Upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn9.8:2.4: mañ ca tañ ca kim antaran- ti || || 5.
